items.title: Making school outreach easier to teach
items.description: At Treering, I organized 129 Outreach sequences, created a 14-category campaign QA checklist, and built reusable training resources for more than 20 teammates. A content library is only useful when people can find it, trust it, and know how to use it.

items.title: One product, three school audiences
items.description: A messaging exercise for Curipod: three ways to introduce the same classroom tool, tailored to the priorities of a teacher, a technology director, and a curriculum director.

items.title: A better time to follow up
items.description: A Treering nurture approach built around the prospect's own timeline. The sequence acknowledged when a school was ready to revisit a decision, then used light-touch reminders and useful next steps to keep the relationship warm.

items.title: When the contract isn't up yet
items.description: A long-term objection-handling sequence for schools already committed to another yearbook provider. The messaging paired patient follow-up with useful resources and a clear explanation of Treering's contract-free model.

items.title: The story behind the numbers
items.description: For CommunityAmerica Credit Union, I wrote family financial makeover profiles that brought financial coaching to life through real member experiences rather than institutional messaging.

items.title: A field guide for better pet-nutrition conversations
items.description: For Hill's Science Diet through Callahan Creek, I helped translate technical pet-nutrition information into practical training and conversation guidance for retail partners.

items.title: Turning a sample into a conversation
items.description: A Treering follow-up sequence designed to bridge the gap between delivery of a physical yearbook sample and a prospect's next step, with useful resources and flexible ways to engage.

items.title: A digital path to the booking button
items.description: A VML strategy project for Carlson Hotels. Consumer insight and competitive research shaped a cross-channel concept that made the value of booking online feel clear and easy.

items.title: Stories that bring a mission closer
items.description: Volunteer profiles and community stories for the Humane Society of Greater Kansas City, connecting individual experiences with the wider work of the organization.

items.title: A reusable job-search toolkit
items.description: An open-source, local-first resume and job-search toolkit built around verified accomplishments and a free-access design principle. The project turns repetitive application work into a more structured workflow.

items.title: Cannoli
items.description: A visual builder and layout sandbox for terminal interfaces in the Charm ecosystem. Explore components, experiment with layouts, and make terminal UI design more approachable.
